# BrewLog

> BrewLog is a home coffee brewing journal that helps hobbyists log beans, brew recipes, and taste notes to learn what they like.

## About
BrewLog is a warm, focused notebook for home baristas and coffee hobbyists. It captures every brew parameter — beans, dose, yield, time, temperature, ratio — alongside ratings and taste notes, so you can see patterns across roasts and methods and dial in better cups over time.

## Key Features
- Bean library: roaster, origin, roast level, and tasting impressions
- Brew logging for V60, Aeropress, Espresso, French Press, and Chemex
- Real-time brew ratio calculation (dose to yield)
- 1-to-5 cup ratings with free-form taste notes
- Timeline view to spot patterns across brews and beans
- Private journal — only the account owner sees their data

## Target Users
- Home baristas
- Pour-over enthusiasts (V60, Chemex, Kalita)
- Home espresso hobbyists
- Aeropress and immersion brewers
- Anyone learning their personal coffee taste
